messages:
maria: Quick accessibility pass on the Console — flagged a handful of small but high-impact nits after testing with VoiceOver and keyboard-only nav. Posting the list so we can triage for next sprint :memo:

sam: thanks — pls paste the exact repro steps/screen so I can patch quickly. :+1:

maria: repro summary:
• Dark theme: Primary CTA (filled purple) drops to 3.4:1 at 12px label — fails AA button contrast 
• Focus ring on small pill toggles almost invisible at 2x zoom (seems to be 1px rgba on top of shadow)
• Model details drawer: keyboard trap when opening the settings cog (tab stops inside drawer but Shift+Tab doesn't restore focus to [Model row])
• Copy icon next to Model ID has no aria-label — VoiceOver reads “button”
• Table row expand chevron is announced as “button collapsed” with no context; should include row title

jun: rough timestamps are helpful — where were you testing (mac/chrome or mac/safari/voiceover)?

maria: mac + safari + VoiceOver for screenreader checks. Also ran axe CLI on the page for automated catches — it flagged contrast + missing aria-labels. I can attach screenshots in a follow up thread if helpful.

sam: ok. plan: 1) bump focus ring to 3px solid with clear offset and use theme token (so it scales for dark/light) 2) change purple fill (#6f4fff?) to a11y token that hits 4.5:1 at 12px or bump text weight/size 3) add aria-labels for copy icons + expand chevron 4) keyboard trap — probably focus containment code not calling restoreFocus on close. I'll investigate.

maria: sweet. For the color — I found this quick diff in the inspector that nails 4.6:1: `--color-primary: #5b3bff;` — might be slightly darker than current token.

sam: can you drop the CSS snippet? also adding the :focus-visible rule helps for keyboard users.

maria: CSS snippets:
```css
/* focus ring for small controls */
.control--pill:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  box-shadow: none; /* remove faint shadow that blends */
}

/* accessible primary color */
:root {
  --color-primary: #5b3bff; /* meets AA 4.5:1 at 12px */
}
```

designer_josh: small copy nits while we're here: change tooltip from "Copy ID" to "Copy model ID" (gives SR context). Also expand chevron announce text -> `aria-label="Expand row for {modelName}"`. That fixes the vague "button" announce.

jun: i'll add the aria-labels in the component (ModelRow.tsx). For the copy icon i'll add `aria-label={\`Copy model id ${model.id}\`}` and ensure the button type is `button` so SR reads it as a control.

a11y-bot: Automated scan results: 6 new issues found. Severity: 2 high (contrast, keyboard trap), 4 medium (missing ARIA labels, ambiguous announcements). See /internal/a11y/reports/1876543210 for full output.

olivia: prioritize? i'd vote we include contrast + keyboard trap in the next sprint (P0), aria labels and copy tweaks P1. Agree?

maria: agree on prioritization. keyboard trap causes real regressions for screen reader flows.

sam: i'll whip up a PR with CSS + focus restoration fix. will link draft by EOD.

jun: i'll follow with aria-label PR and tiny test that asserts expanded chevron includes row title in accessible name.

designer_josh: i'll update the Figma components for the new focus token and adjusted primary color so visuals match.

maria: thanks team. quick checklist for the PRs:
- [ ] contrast token bumped and visual QA in dark/light
- [ ] focus-visible rule + unit test for keyboard focus styles
- [ ] restoreFocus on drawer close (keyboard trap fix) + e2e keyboard test
- [ ] aria-labels for copy icon and expand chevron (include examples)
- [ ] copy tweak: "Copy model ID" tooltip + SR-friendly chevron label

sam: copying checklist into the PR description. tagging @olivia for prioritization. :eyes:

olivia: got it — I'll slot the contrast + keyboard trap into sprint planning. Please flag if anything blocks release.

maria: i'll run another quick pass with VoiceOver after the PRs land and post one-line verification. thanks all :heart:

sam: :rocket:
